script.title: A WALLET COMES HOME
script.scene_zh: 公園長椅 · 歸還錢包
script.story_hook: A park guard calls the owner of a wallet.
script.intro_zh: 公園管理員打電話給遺失錢包的主人。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone, welcome back! Today someone returns a lost wallet.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨各位，歡迎回來！今天我們來聽一個歸還錢包的故事。
script.outro: That's all for today! Honesty sounds great, right?
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！誠實的感覺真好，對吧？
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each line, just like a phone call.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們像講電話一樣，一句一句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a friendly man in his forties with short salt-and-pepper hair and light stubble, wearing a brown canvas utility vest over a cream long sleeve tee, holding his phone with both hands while he grins
script.char_b_description: a petite East Asian woman in her mid thirties with straight black hair cut at the chin, wearing a lilac knit sweater and pearl earrings, pressing her hand to her mouth in relief
script.youtube_title: 【👛撿到錢包怎麼辦】「再也回不來了」怎麼說？📞確認身分與婉拒酬謝的電話英文✨｜Lost Wallet English
script.youtube_title_en: "I Thought It Was Gone Forever" — Returning a Lost Wallet
script.youtube_description:
撿到錢包，第一通電話該怎麼打？失主又該怎麼確認身分、表達感謝？這集是一通完整的歸還錢包電話：自我介紹、核對證件、描述內物、相約時間，還有婉拒酬金與堅持請喝咖啡的來回客套。整段 18 句自然美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完這種場合不再緊張。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英文變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
You just found someone's wallet — how do you make that first phone call? And how does the owner confirm their identity and say thanks? This episode is one complete call: introducing yourself, checking the ID, describing what's inside, making a meetup plan, and the sweet back-and-forth over rewards and coffee treats. 18 lines of natural American English with IPA and translations, plus a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】👛歸還錢包英文｜電話確認身分・描述內物・婉拒酬金｜聽完就會處理失物｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
在公園長椅上撿到一個錢包，你敢直接打電話給失主嗎？
電話裡要怎麼核對身分、怎麼約見面？

這一集帶大家走進一通真實的歸還電話，跟著公園管理員 Sam 從一句自我介紹開始，確認證件、描述內物、相約車站旁的咖啡廳，還客氣地婉拒酬金，換失主 Grace 真心道謝。

你會聽到：
📞 開場與核對：例如「Is this the owner of a lost wallet?」、「Can you describe what's inside?」。
☕ 相約與客套：例如「When can you come pick it up?」、「Does six o'clock work for you?」。
💛 道謝與婉拒：例如「Thank you so much for taking care of it.」、「No reward needed, honestly.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把打電話的英文練到脫口而出。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

希望你的英文，也能這樣把溫柔傳出去！
script.thumbnail_action: holding a phone to one ear and a green wallet in the other hand
script.title_quote: i thought it was gone forever

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, is this the owner of a lost wallet?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ ɪs ði ˈoʊnər əv ə lɔst ˈwɑlɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你好，請問是遺失錢包的朋友嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Is my wallet okay? Who's this?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪs maɪ ˈwɑlɪt ˈoʊkeɪ huz ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 是的！我的錢包沒事吧？請問你是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm Sam, a park guard. It's safe and sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm sæm ə pɑrk ɡɑrd ɪts seɪf ænd saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 我是山姆，公園管理員。錢包完好無損。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh my gosh, I thought it was gone forever!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ ɡɑʃ aɪ θɔt ɪt wəz ɡɔn fərˈɛvər/
dialogue.zh: 天啊，我以為它再也回不來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we meet, can you describe what's inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr wi mit kæn ju dɪˈskraɪb wʌts ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 先確認一下，裡面有什麼可以跟我說嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's green, with my daughter's photo tucked in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɡrin wɪð maɪ ˈdɔtərz ˈfoʊtoʊ tʌkt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 是綠色的，裡面夾著我家小孩的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's it! Also your ID and some cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæts ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ jɔr ˌaɪ ˈdi ænd səm kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 完全對上！還有你的證件跟一些現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for taking care of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju soʊ mʌʧ fər ˈteɪkɪŋ kɛr əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太謝謝你幫忙保管它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No trouble. When can you come pick it up?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈtrʌbl wɛn kæn ju kəm pɪk ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 不麻煩，你何時方便來取呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today if possible! I can meet you anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪf ˈpɑsəbl aɪ kæn mit ju ˈɛnɪwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 今天可以嗎？我在哪裡見面都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about the café by the train station?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt ðə kæˈfeɪ baɪ ðə treɪn ˈsteɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 火車站旁的咖啡廳怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Does six o'clock work for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt dʌz sɪks əˈklɑk wɜrk fər ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is great. I'll bring it with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪz ɡreɪt aɪl brɪŋ ɪt wɪθ mi/
dialogue.zh: 六點很好。我會把錢包帶過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to give you a reward, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə ɡɪv ju ə rɪˈwɔrd ˈsɪriəsli/
dialogue.zh: 我想給你一點酬謝，真的請收下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No reward needed, honestly. It's nothing, really.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɪˈwɔrd ˈnidəd ˈɑnəstli ɪts ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 不用酬謝啦，真的，這只是舉手之勞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then at least let me buy you a coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ət ˈlist lɛt mi baɪ ju ə ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 那至少讓我請你喝杯咖啡好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, okay, deal. See you at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈoʊkeɪ dil si ju ət sɪks/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you at six. Have a wonderful afternoon!
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ət sɪks hæv ə ˈwʌndərfəl ˈæftərˌnun/
dialogue.zh: 六點見，祝你有個愉快的下午！
